l.i: Ecclesiarumque ministros, ut hanc modestam & veram doctrinam fidis
animis custodiant; & caveant sibi à fermento ac
cere; sed volui Disputationem illam repetere
posset me ante hac aliter do-
perfrictæ frontis homo id mihi ob-

page.notes: The catchword at the foot is set in the same italic and is hard to read; I have given it as "ctrina" with a doubt mark. The running text ends with "do-" hyphenated at the line end, and the word continues on the catchword line as "ctrina". The long s is printed as f-like forms throughout and is rendered here as s. The "et" is set as a ligature. No page number is printed.
